Questions

Frequently asked questions

How do I book a vehicle?

Call us on 0333 5514114, message us on WhatsApp, or use the booking form at the top of this page. We will confirm availability and details with you.

Are you open at night?

Yes. We are open 24 hours, and our car support runs day and night.

Which areas do you serve?

We are based in Satellite Town, Rawalpindi and serve Rawalpindi and Islamabad, with pickups from many locations. Tell us where you need the vehicle.

Can I rent for just a few hours?

Yes. Whether you need a car for a few hours, a business trip, a wedding or a longer tour, get in touch and we will arrange it.

How much does it cost?

Rates depend on the vehicle, the date and the trip. Send us your details and we will quote you quickly.
